patterns.import_style: Django imports first (grouped), then third-party, then local imports. Example: apps/accounts/views.py lines 1-9
patterns.docstring_style: Triple-quoted strings, mix of Portuguese and English. Models have Portuguese verbose_name
patterns.model_patterns: Abstract base models exist (TimeStampedModel, BaseModel) in apps/core/models.py
patterns.view_patterns: Mix of class-based views (LoginView, CreateView) and function-based views with @login_required decorator
